title: Electronic device recovery system; consumer education.
bodyText:
(a) The department shall develop a consumer education program about the electronic device recycling program.

(b) Beginning January 1, 2023, the department shall display on its website a toll-free number and current information on electronic device recycling locations.
bodyHtml:
§339D-25  Electronic device recovery system; consumer education.  (a)  The department shall develop a consumer education program about the electronic device recycling program.

     (b)  Beginning January 1, 2023, the department shall display on its website a toll-free number and current information on electronic device recycling locations. [L 2009, c 183, pt of §6; am L 2022, c 151, §14]
